properties.displayName: AuditEvent ASIM filtering parser for Salesforce Real-Time Event Monitoring
properties.query:
// Schema: AuditEvent 1.0.0. Permission definitions, not business-record CRUD.
let parser = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null),
    endtime: datetime = datetime(null),
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    eventtype_in: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    eventresult: string = "",
    actorusername_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    operation_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    object_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    newvalue_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    disabled: bool = false,
    pack: bool = false
) {
    let _actorusername_has_any = case(isnull(actorusername_has_any) or tostring(actorusername_has_any) == "", dynamic([]), gettype(actorusername_has_any) == "array", actorusername_has_any, pack_array(tostring(actorusername_has_any)));
    let _operation_has_any = case(isnull(operation_has_any) or tostring(operation_has_any) == "", dynamic([]), gettype(operation_has_any) == "array", operation_has_any, pack_array(tostring(operation_has_any)));
    let _object_has_any = case(isnull(object_has_any) or tostring(object_has_any) == "", dynamic([]), gettype(object_has_any) == "array", object_has_any, pack_array(tostring(object_has_any)));
    let _newvalue_has_any = case(isnull(newvalue_has_any) or tostring(newvalue_has_any) == "", dynamic([]), gettype(newvalue_has_any) == "array", newvalue_has_any, pack_array(tostring(newvalue_has_any)));
    SalesForceRealTimeEventMonitoring_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime
    | where isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime
    | where EventType == "PermissionSetEventStore"
    | where Operation !in ("AssignedToUsers", "UnassignedFromUsers")
    | where array_length(_actorusername_has_any) == 0 or UserNameDetail has_any (_actorusername_has_any)
    | where array_length(_operation_has_any) == 0 or Operation has_any (_operation_has_any)
    | extend
        _SourceType = EventType,
        _Org = SalesforceDomain,
        SrcIpAddr = iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(SourceIp)) or isnotempty(parse_ipv6(SourceIp)), SourceIp, "")
    | where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or SrcIpAddr in (srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) or has_any_ipv4_prefix(SrcIpAddr, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | extend
        EventType = case(
            Operation in ("PermsEnabled", "CriticalPerms"), "Enable",
            Operation == "PermsDisabled", "Disable",
            "Other")
    | where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in (eventtype_in)
    | extend
        EventResult = case(
            PolicyOutcome in ("Block", "MeteringBlock", "EndSession", "TwoFADenied", "TwoFAReportedDenied")
                or PolicyOutcome startswith "Failed" or PolicyOutcome startswith "TwoFAFailed", "Failure",
            PolicyOutcome in ("", "NoAction", "ExemptNoAction", "MeteringNoAction", "Notified",
                "TwoFANoAction", "TwoFASucceeded", "TwoFAAutomatedSuccess"), "Success",
            "NA")
    | where isempty(eventresult) or EventResult == eventresult
    | extend
        Object = case(
            array_length(ParentNameList) == 1, tostring(ParentNameList[0]),
            array_length(ParentNameList) > 1, tostring(ParentNameList),
            array_length(ParentIdList) == 1, tostring(ParentIdList[0]),
            array_length(ParentIdList) > 1, tostring(ParentIdList),
            tostring(PermissionList))
    | where array_length(_object_has_any) == 0 or Object has_any (_object_has_any)
    | extend
        NewValue = iff(Operation in ("PermsEnabled", "CriticalPerms"), tostring(PermissionList), "")
    | where array_length(_newvalue_has_any) == 0 or NewValue has_any (_newvalue_has_any)
    | extend
        _OrgHost = tostring(parse_url(iff(_Org contains "://", _Org, strcat("https://", _Org))).Host)
    | extend
        EventStartTime = coalesce(EventDate, TimeGenerated),
        EventEndTime = coalesce(EventDate, TimeGenerated),
        EventCount = toint(1),
        EventVendor = "Salesforce",
        EventProduct = "Real-Time Event Monitoring",
        EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventOriginalType = _SourceType,
        EventSubType = PermissionType,
        EventSeverity = "Informational",
        EventUid = coalesce(EventIdentifier, SalesforceObjectId, EventUuid),
        EventOriginalUid = SalesforceObjectId,
        EventOriginalResultDetails = PolicyOutcome,
        EventMessage = Operation,
        ObjectId = iff(array_length(ParentIdList) == 1, tostring(ParentIdList[0]), ""),
        ObjectType = "Configuration Atom",
        OriginalObjectType = PermissionType,
        OldValue = iff(Operation == "PermsDisabled", tostring(PermissionList), ""),
        Value = NewValue,
        ValueType = iff(array_length(PermissionList) > 0, "Other", ""),
        Dvc = coalesce(_OrgHost, "Salesforce Real-Time Event Monitoring"),
        DvcFQDN = _OrgHost,
        DvcHostname = tostring(split(_OrgHost, ".")[0]),
        DvcDomain = iff(indexof(_OrgHost, ".") >= 0, substring(_OrgHost, indexof(_OrgHost, ".") + 1), ""),
        DvcScope = _OrgHost,
        DvcOriginalAction = PolicyOutcome,
        DvcAction = case(
            PolicyOutcome in ("Block", "MeteringBlock"), "Deny",
            PolicyOutcome == "EndSession", "Terminate",
            PolicyOutcome in ("NoAction", "ExemptNoAction", "MeteringNoAction", "Notified",
                "TwoFANoAction", "TwoFASucceeded", "TwoFAAutomatedSuccess"), "Allow",
            ""),
        ActorUserId = UserId,
        ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(UserId), "", "SalesforceId"),
        ActorUsername = UserNameDetail,
        ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(UserNameDetail), "", iff(UserNameDetail contains "@", "UPN", "Simple")),
        ActorScope = _OrgHost,
        ActorSessionId = SessionKey,
        ActingAppName = EventSource,
        ActingAppType = iff(isempty(EventSource), "", "SaaS application"),
        ActingOriginalAppType = EventSource,
        TargetAppName = "Salesforce",
        TargetAppType = "SaaS application",
        RuleName = coalesce(PolicyId, Policy),
        AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
            "ParentIdList", ParentIdList, "ParentNameList", ParentNameList,
            "PermissionList", PermissionList, "PermissionType", PermissionType,
            "ImpactedUserIds", ImpactedUserIds, "UserCount", UserCount,
            "HasExternalUsers", HasExternalUsers,
            "PermissionExpiration", PermissionExpiration,
            "PermissionExpirationList", PermissionExpirationList,
            "LoginKey", LoginKey, "SourceIp", SourceIp,
            "LoginHistoryId", LoginHistoryId, "SessionLevel", SessionLevel,
            "RelatedEventIdentifier", RelatedEventIdentifier,
            "PolicyOutcome", PolicyOutcome, "EvaluationTime", EvaluationTime), dynamic({})),
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        ActorUserEntityKey = "",
        SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
        TargetSystemEntityKey = "",
        ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
        TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
        ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([])
    | extend
        DvcDomainType = iff(isempty(DvcDomain), "", "FQDN"),
        Src = SrcIpAddr,
        IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
        User = ActorUsername,
        Application = TargetAppName,
        Dst = TargetAppName,
        Rule = RuleName
    | project
        TimeGenerated, Type, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventCount,
        EventVendor, EventProduct, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion,
        EventOriginalType, EventSubType, EventType, EventResult, EventSeverity,
        EventUid, EventOriginalUid, EventOriginalResultDetails, EventMessage,
        Operation, Object, ObjectId, ObjectType, OriginalObjectType,
        OldValue, NewValue, Value, ValueType,
        Dvc, DvcFQDN, DvcHostname, DvcDomain, DvcDomainType, DvcScope, DvcOriginalAction, DvcAction,
        ActorUserId, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsername, ActorUsernameType,
        ActorScope, ActorSessionId, User, SrcIpAddr, Src, IpAddr,
        ActingAppName, ActingAppType, ActingOriginalAppType,
        TargetAppName, TargetAppType, Application, Dst, RuleName, Rule,
        AdditionalFields, DvcEntityKey, ActorUserEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
        TargetSystemEntityKey, ActingApplicationEntityKey, TargetApplicationEntityKey,
        ActorUserAdditionalIds, AdditionalEntities
};
parser(starttime, endtime, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix, eventtype_in, eventresult,
    actorusername_has_any, operation_has_any, object_has_any, newvalue_has_any, disabled, pack)
